verdict.rationale: Gunderson Dettmer is a law firm, but it ships client-facing software (GDHQ, the Contract Generator, the D&O Questionnaire Portal, SMART Request intake forms and the Catalyze platform), so event-triggered automation is a fair question. Nothing in the evidence shows user-definable rules that fire actions automatically on events. The probes also found no API or OpenAPI surface, and the self-service document tools and ChatGD are a different capability, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
